decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core building block in the modular system and was elevated to its own page in 2024, signalling visible commitment and investment that management would not write off.
The industrial AC input module was publicly announced as a launch, has had its own page in both years and fits the industrial direction, so dropping it would contradict an announced course.
The relay module sits close to the established offer and costs little to keep in stock, though it has only been mentioned rather than featured, which leaves some risk of quiet discontinuation.

The recently launched LED control module has had too little time to show its results, so weak early figures can still be attributed to the ramp-up period, but its low visible commitment makes a drop somewhat plausible.
The wallbox remote access service supports the announced expansion into charging and energy management, so it is central to the firm's stated direction and worth persisting with.
